description: Update an existing record by id (from list_records). Pass `data` to merge field values (fields you don't pass are unchanged), `status` to transition the record's lifecycle state, and/or `published` to take it on or off the site. At least one of data/status/published is required. Each record carries `url`: its live storefront link, built by the server from the model's urlPattern and the site's public site URL. Use it whenever you link to a record and never build a storefront URL yourself (not from a slug, not from the site address). When url is null or missing, say why instead of guessing: the model has no urlPattern (set it with update_model), the model is not delivered (deliveryAccess none, or it is the login model), the site has no public site URL, or the record - or one it links to - is unpublished.

data.description: The field values to change, keyed by the model's field keys. Merged into the record's current data - fields you don't pass are unchanged. A translatable field (localized: true on the model) takes a language map, e.g. { title: { pl: 'Łożysko' } }; the languages you don't pass are kept, so you can add one translation without resending the others.

published.description: Publish (true) or unpublish (false) the record. An unpublished record stays off every public read - lists, relations, prices, cart - until published again. Separate from status, which is only a workflow label.

status.description: New status value to transition the record to (validated against the model's statusField transitions).

name: update_record
title: Update record
